title: Assertion: Count Is Zero After Reset
constraints: Rule: at the rising edge right after an edge where `rst = 1` was sampled, `count` must be 0.
This property is **about** reset, so it must not be disabled by reset.
Report a violation with a failing assertion (or `$error`). Legal traces must produce no error. `rst` is active high; ignore everything while it is asserted.
hints: Don't use `disable iff (rst)` here, or the property can never fire.

examples.title: after reset
examples.input: count increments once rst is low
